steps.title: The green arrow
steps.say: The green arrow is a shift: it shows the whole demand curve moving right, from D1 to D2, not a movement along the curve.

ops.text:
Green arrow = shift of the
whole demand curve (D1 → D2)

steps.title: Shift vs. movement
steps.say: A shift means buyers want more at every price. Moving along a curve only happens when the price itself changes.
